TextView.android:text:
Starting me laga tha Android development matlab mast UI banana, colors lagana, buttons round karna, thoda animation daal diya aur app ready 😌
Phir XML ne reality check de diya.
Ek button center karne jao toh poora layout hil jaata bhai. ConstraintLayout ka ek constraint missing ho toh views Mars pe chale jaate hain 🚀. Padding alag drama, margin alag drama
Not gonna lie after fighting with layouts, dp, sp, nested views for hours I slowly realized:
“Backend zyada peaceful hai bhai.”
At least backend me logic hota hai 😭. Input diya → output aaya. Firebase me data gaya → data aaya. Simple. UI me toh kabhi button invisible, kabhi text cut, kabhi scroll missing, aur kabhi pura app Picasso painting ban jaata hai.
So yeah after practicing views and layouts, I discovered something important: I don’t hate Android development I just emotionally connect more with backend now 😌☕
